name: GFX_hof_ic_malenkow_the_party_schools
title: 党校
concept: A quiet empty training classroom: one ordered ROW of wooden school desks receding toward a DEEP MUTED GREEN chalkboard. Chalkboard shows only a few abstract outline strokes and horizontal bars suggesting an outline; NO recognizable letters, Cyrillic, Chinese, numerals or icons. Wood, cream chalk and deep dark green chalkboard only. No people, portraits, flags or central red.
prompt: Create ONE finished Hearts of Iron IV Soviet national focus icon. Use attached image ONLY as stylistic reference for the shared outer engraved gold laurel wreath, small red star and blank gold ribbon; create a NEW central scene. A quiet empty training classroom: one ordered ROW of wooden school desks receding toward a DEEP MUTED GREEN chalkboard. Chalkboard shows only a few abstract outline strokes and horizontal bars suggesting an outline; NO recognizable letters, Cyrillic, Chinese, numerals or icons. Wood, cream chalk and deep dark green chalkboard only. No people, portraits, flags or central red. Central art style: restrained, realistic 1930s-1950s Soviet sculptural relief, tactile wood, aged paper and objects. Color ONLY from depicted objects, never an overall color wash. The outer ornamental star may remain red on all six; within the central scene red is permitted ONLY on the desk stamp for the cadres directorate image and forbidden on all other images. Exactly one centered emblem in square canvas; composition must read clearly at 100x88. TRUE RGBA transparent outside wreath and ribbon, alpha 0 at all four corners, 20-50 percent broad transparent exterior. No legible typography, numerals, watermark, faces, people, uniforms, weapons, executions, prison bars, concentration camp, blacklisted or torn names, Leningrad buildings, German symbols, rockets, mushroom cloud, factory floor, warships, naval chart, hammer-and-sickle portrait, neon or glow. Output one final production icon, not mockup or sheet.
